verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs show alerting through Triggers and SLOs, with routing to PagerDuty, OpsGenie and incident.io webhooks. That hands incident response off to third-party tools. There is no evidence that Honeycomb itself lets you declare incidents, track incident timelines, or manage on-call schedules and escalation policies. Incident management is a fair question for an observability platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
